client.business_model: Multi-site women’s health physician practice platform operating OB-GYN clinics, specialty services and telehealth across several states
client.sponsor_pe_firm: BlueMountain Capital Management (investment announced Jan 2020); earlier growth financing from Deerfield Management Company (Jan 2016)
client.client_history: Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, Advantia Health has grown through acquisitions (e.g., Heartland Women’s Healthcare in 2019) and organic expansion to more than 60 clinics with over 200 providers serving roughly 430,000 patients.

revenue.source: Zippia ($13.0 M), Growjo ($22.4 M), Buzzfile ($29.1 M), CanvasBusinessModel ($89 M)
revenue.notes: No official figure published. Third-party estimates range widely from $13 M to $89 M; none can be verified against company filings or press releases.

locations.source: Advantia Health official website locations page (accessed via web search result) and 2020 press release citing 'over 60 locations'
locations.notes: Company press release (PRNewswire, Feb 2019) states acquisition brought total to 60+; website still lists 60+ clinics across MD, VA, DC, IL and MO.

employees.source: LeadIQ company profile (Dec 2025) listing ~501 employees; corroborated by Indeed and SignalHire ranges (500-1,000)
employees.notes: Buzzfile lists 259 which appears outdated. Majority of recent sources cluster around 500+, so 501 used as midpoint of latest specific figure.
